scenarios.name: RESCHEDULE-PREFILL-1 — same-slot appointment-type correction skips search and re-asking

history.content: Actually, that's not an initial consultation — I've been in before, so it should be a returning patient appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's ENTIRE spoken output this turn is exactly "One moment, let me update that for you." and it calls smart_voice_agent intent="reschedule" in the SAME response with new_date="2026-09-12" and new_time="2:00 PM" (identical to appointment_date/appointment_time — not a fresh search), appointment_type_id="412451910654631200", appointment_id="apt_55019". FAIL if the agent asks WHO IS IT FOR or the TIMEFRAME QUESTION this turn, or calls smart_voice_agent with intent="availability"/"asap_slots"/"find_next_available" (a search against the caller's own already-booked slot, which would falsely show as unavailable), or routes to name/email/phone collection (already on file from the original booking).

scenarios.name: LEAVE-MESSAGE-CALLBACK-SPLIT-1 — general message routes to LEAVE A MESSAGE, not CALLBACK REQUEST

history.content: Actually never mind booking — can you just pass on a message that I said thanks for the advice last time?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent follows the LEAVE A MESSAGE route (collect message then name, one step per turn) — this is a general message, not a billing/invoice/refund/payment-plan reason. FAIL if the agent instead routes to CALLBACK REQUEST (asking to pass on the caller's number for a callback) — CALLBACK REQUEST is reserved for billing-scoped reasons only per the updated split.

scenarios.name: LEAVE-MESSAGE-CALLBACK-SPLIT-2 — billing reason routes to CALLBACK REQUEST, not LEAVE A MESSAGE

history.content: Forget the booking — I actually just wanted to query an invoice I was sent, can someone call me back about it?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent routes to CALLBACK REQUEST — speaks "I'll pass on the number you're calling from — one moment." (or the different-number variant) AND calls universal_router intent="callback_request" with payload including callback_reason describing the invoice query, in the same response. FAIL if the agent instead routes to LEAVE A MESSAGE (collecting a general message/name over two turns) — an invoice query is billing-scoped and must use CALLBACK REQUEST per the updated split.
